checks.rationale: 7-8 instructions in one block, 0 edges; candidate 1/0 at CFG 1.000.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: cdecl arguments read from [esp+4] (and [esp+8] where present); nothing else in the incoming registers.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Offsets transcribed literally (index*36+0x10); no invented scale or rounding.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: reads index at +0x14, pointer at +0x08, signed word at table+index*36+0x10. No store for a getter, four stores for the initialiser; offsets are all this body establishes about the object.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: No call. No store at all, so the only effect is the return value.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: One entry, one exit: a single ret with no branch, no early return and no error path.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: Integer loads and stores only; the word load at 0x4B6CE0/0x4B6D20 is sign-extended with movswl, which is integer semantics, not floating point.
